sources.label: Custom patches for the german DB Navigator
sources.author: henr1klmb
patch_list: Replaces dark background colors in night mode with pure black (#FF000000).
Prevents the Adjust analytics SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.
Prevents the Instana monitoring and telemetry SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.
Prevents the Optimizely SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.
Prevents the Qualtrics SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.
Prevents the Tealium analytics SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.
Removes the FLAG_SECURE window flag in DB Navigator to allow taking screenshots and screen recordings.
